title: Course Schedule III
statement:
There are `n` different online courses numbered from `1` to `n`. You are given an array `courses` where `courses[i] = [durationi, lastDayi]` indicate that the `i`th course should be taken continuously for `durationi` days and must be finished before or on `lastDayi`.
You will start on the 1st day and you cannot take two or more courses simultaneously.

Return the maximum number of courses that you can take.
inputFormat:
Line 1: an integer N.
Next N lines: two space-separated integers `duration` and `lastDay`.
outputFormat: A single integer denoting the max achievable courses.

examples.explanation: Take course 1 (finish at 100), course 3 (finish at 1100), and course 2 (finish at 1300).

starterCode.python:
n = int(input())
courses = [tuple(map(int, input().split())) for _ in range(n)]
# Greedy: Sort by lastDay, use Max Heap to optimally remove longest passed courses if deadline missed.
